decisions.reason: The organic sliced salami platter is the strategic flagship and rests directly on the firm's curing, maturation and organic know-how, so management can interpret its results and refine the line within existing competencies.

The organic poultry mini salami builds on established salami expertise and fits the organic growth path, but the snack format is close to the withdrawn sharing snack, so the risk is somewhat elevated though not enough to drop it.
Organic Fleischwurst is a classic boiled sausage that draws on traditional processing know-how the firm fully commands, making early feedback easy to assimilate and the product easy to improve.

Thinly sliced organic chicken breast extends the firm's established poultry and slicing capabilities into the organic line, and its recent launch with several variants warrants time to learn from market results before any reassessment.

The organic herb-coated salami sits squarely within the firm's in-house seasoning and maturation expertise and supports the organic assortment expansion, so it is well positioned for adjustment rather than withdrawal.
